question: Characterize the smallest function-field carrier of the two specified independent native points in the successful +7 triple, and its exact specialization solubility condition.
selection: Only 0b2d0 and 19e45, the independent pair in the frozen triple relation. Use the retained parameter solely as a rational origin on the auxiliary carrier. This is a retrospective characterization, not an absolute minimality claim over other constructions.
method: Use the smooth complete intersection u^2=f(t),v^2=g(t), its free simultaneous-sign involution and genus-one quotient w^2=f(t)g(t). Reconstruct a quartic and its Jacobian from the retained rational conic point. Optionally run PARI ellrank at effort zero with a 64 MiB initial stack, once, to bound this auxiliary Jacobian's rank. A rational product-root point lifts exactly when f(t) is a rational square. The degree-12 triple intersection supplies a stronger sufficient condition whose rational factor must be verified independently.
failure_semantics: Auxiliary rank failure or timeout leaves rank UNKNOWN; the explicit rational origin already proves carrier solubility. Neither a product square nor carrier Jacobian rank proves independent original-curve points at a prescribed parameter. Minimality refers only to making the specified marked lift maps rational.
boundary: An explicit genus-one carrier, a degree-two isogeny lifting obstruction, and a separately certified two-direction specialization. No visibility score or new prospective selector.
